components.name: Map loader
components.purpose: Loads the whole map from the server when the page opens, before any screen is drawn. Glossary words in the text then become definitions you can read in place.

components.name: Element cards
components.purpose: Draws one card for anything on the map: its name, a tag saying its type, one sentence. Clicking a card opens that thing.

components.name: Diagram canvas
components.purpose: Draws a view's picture from the drawing the map recorded. Selecting a box lights it and everything it touches, and dims the rest.

components.name: Diagram clicks
components.purpose: Decides what a click does on each drawn box and arrow, view by view. Holding a key drills into a box instead of selecting it.

components.name: Info pane
components.purpose: Shows what you selected: a card floating over the picture, or a drawer along the bottom. What the pane holds changes with the kind of thing selected.

components.name: Trail and screen address
components.purpose: Keeps the tabs, the trail and the browser address in step with the screen on show. Copying that address gives someone else the same screen.

components.name: Product pages
components.purpose: Draws the pages that say what the product is for and what it does. Covers the overview, the features, the happy path, actor pages and the glossary.

components.name: Storage, tests and system pages
components.purpose: Draws the tables for where data is kept, how far the tests reach, and the operational lists.

components.name: Rules and interfaces pages
components.purpose: Draws the decisions the product makes and the places it meets the outside world. Each rule and each interface has a page of its own.

components.name: Source column
components.purpose: Shows the mapped project's files, and the source of the one you open, at the map's commit. Selecting a box on a picture opens its file here.

components.name: Viewer shell
components.purpose: Holds the page frame: the title bar, the tab rows, the panes and the settings dialog. Also wires the keyboard and the first-run guide.

components.name: Map search
components.purpose: Finds anything in the map by name as you type: elements, files, folders, glossary words. Picking a result opens it where it lives.

components.name: Impact explorer
components.purpose: Projects a code change onto the map and marks what that change touches, plus what ripples out from it. Hidden from the title bar for now.

components.name: Viewer styles
components.purpose: Holds every colour, size and layout rule the viewer page draws itself with. One stylesheet covers every view.

entry_points.trigger: Opening `#v=overview` shows the sentences saying what the product is for.
Opening `#v=features` lists everything the product does, one card per feature.
Opening `#v=hp` shows the product's one successful run, end to end.
Opening `#v=interfaces` shows every place the product meets the outside world.
Opening `#v=rules` shows the decisions the product makes, grouped by area.
Opening `#v=domain` shows the things the product knows about.
Opening `#v=glossary` shows the product's own words and what each one means.
Opening `#v=container` draws the subsystems the code is arranged into.
Opening `#v=data` shows where the product's data physically lives.
Opening `#v=context` draws what the product depends on outside itself.
Opening `#v=tests` shows how much of the product the tests reach.
Opening `#v=deployment` draws the processes that run and what each one holds.
Opening `#v=system` shows the operational tables: commands, settings and ways in.
Opening a feature's address shows that feature's page and its use cases.
Opening a use case's address draws that use case's numbered steps.
Opening an actor's address shows what that person or program does, in order.
Opening an element's address shows everything the map holds about that one thing.
Opening a rule's address shows that decision and where the code makes it.
Opening an interface's address shows who is on the far side and what crosses.
Opening a collection's address lists that collection's rows in full.
Opening a subsystem's address draws that subsystem and its neighbours.

deps.name: highlight.js
deps.used_for: Colours the source code shown in the viewer's code pane.

evidence.why: Loaded only once a file is opened, with a checksum the browser checks.

deps.name: cdnjs
deps.used_for: Serves the code-colouring library the viewer page loads when a file is opened.

evidence.why: Names the host the colouring library and its stylesheet are fetched from.

deps.not_an_interface: Its script is fetched into the viewer page and becomes part of it, so no data crosses a surface.

observability.signal: A view that could not be drawn
observability.where_emitted: the viewer page, when a view cannot be drawn: the failure is written to the browser's developer console and a short notice replaces the picture
observability.where_viewed: the reader's own browser developer console; nothing is sent off the machine
observability.alerts: No alerts are configured; the viewer sends nothing anywhere.

config.purpose: Which editor a code link opens in.
config.default: nothing stored, so the reader is asked once before the first open

config.purpose: A reader's own address form for opening a file, when their editor is not offered.
Folder on this machine holding the mapped code, so a code link can point at it.
config.default: the folder the map was built from

config.purpose: Web address of the repository a file opens at, pinned to the map's commit.
config.default: the repository the map was built from, when the map records one

config.purpose: Whether a selected box shows as a drawer along the bottom or a floating card.
Whether the source column is open when the map is reopened.
Whether the search sidebar is open when the map is reopened.
Whether the first-run guide has already been shown to this reader.
config.default: not shown yet, so the guide opens on the first visit
